dkg: Dkg means the same as dekagram or decagram or dag.
dkl: A dkl is a metric unit of volume or capacity equal to 10 liters.
Dkl means the same as dekaliter or dekalitre or decaliter.
dkm: A dkm is a metric unit of length equal to ten meters.
Dkm means the same as decameter or dekameter or decametre.
